COPYING contains PicoDrive's non-commercial source/distribution terms.
cpu/sh2/mame/sh2.c carries its separate Juergen Buchmueller notice; preserve it
in full, credit its authors, and mark any later changes to that source file.
The host-independent dispatch/IRQ bridge in src/core32x/sh2/sh2_interpreter.c
is adapted from cpu/sh2/mame/sh2pico.c and cpu/sh2/sh2.c at the same commit.
No donor MD/CD execution, device emulation, frontend or BIOS dump is included.

DRC subset from the same pinned commit (adapted, not byte-identical):

Changes: see marked source headers and src/core32x/sh2/drc*. No donor MD/CD engine is included.

Exact changes to cpu/sh2/mame/sh2.c:
- Marked the local changes before the complete original copyright notice.
- BF, BFS, BT, BTS disp8 and BRA, BSR disp12 use mask/subtract sign extension.
- EXTS.B and EXTS.W use the same bounded sign-extension arithmetic.
These preserve two's-complement results while removing signed-left-shift UB.

DRC adaptations:
- Compiler includes project drc_internal.h through the build include path,
  so the adapter can be overlaid under GPX core/kega32x without fixed paths.
- Native SH2 layout is unchanged. Compiler references two independent CPU
  pointers and project-owned marker arrays; no Pico global machine/MD/CD code.
- Numeric fetch16 callbacks replace raw BIOS/ROM instruction pointers. All
  data accesses are host callbacks; ROM folding, loop elision and DIV sequence
  optimization are disabled in the initial correctness backend.
- Blocks contain at most 64 decoded instructions; every non-delay instruction
  has a cycle boundary. Compile failures/assertions return through a guarded
  translator frame and the normal JIT register-flush exit, then interpreter.
- Fixed-size 4 MiB generated code cache, bounded donor metadata, checked code
  emission and relative call reach, checked OS executable protection.
- Branch displacement and packed cycle shifts use well-defined arithmetic.
- Donor diagnostic printf output is disabled; no exit/abort paths are retained.
- Failed-translation teardown clears list heads before later engine re-enable.
- cmn.h include guard added; compiler.h instruction limit changed to 64.
